postgres.schemas.answers: every schema row: its jsonb Definition document, the root of the entity foreign-key graph
postgres.schemas.never_for: whether a workflow using it is running now — that is Redis L2, which legitimately lags a PUT until the next start

postgres.processors.answers: every processor row: its SourceHash and optional input/output/config schema ids
postgres.processors.never_for: whether this processor is running now — Postgres holds the registration, Redis liveness keys hold the fact

postgres.steps.answers: every step row: its ProcessorId binding and EntryCondition
postgres.steps.never_for: the step's own successors — those live in the StepNextSteps junction, not on this row; and whether the workflow that owns it is running — that is Redis L2

postgres.assignments.answers: every assignment row: its StepId binding and jsonb Payload
postgres.assignments.never_for: which workflow includes it — that is the WorkflowAssignments junction, not a column here

postgres.workflows.answers: every workflow row: its optional CronExpression; entry steps and assignments live in the two junctions, not here
postgres.workflows.never_for: whether it is running now — L2 legitimately lags a PUT until the next start

postgres.step_next_steps.answers: the workflow graph's edges — which StepId may flow into which NextStepId; the source of truth for successors, since StepEntity carries neither the collection nor a navigation property
postgres.step_next_steps.never_for: whether the workflow built from these edges is running — that is Redis L2, not this table

postgres.workflow_entry_steps.answers: which steps a workflow enters at — the source of truth for entry steps, since WorkflowEntity carries no collection or navigation property
postgres.workflow_entry_steps.never_for: whether that workflow is currently projected — L2, which lags a PUT until the next start

postgres.workflow_assignments.answers: which assignments (processor payload bindings) a workflow includes — the source of truth, since neither WorkflowEntity nor AssignmentEntity carries the link
postgres.workflow_assignments.never_for: whether that workflow is currently projected — L2, which lags a PUT until the next start
